current.jp: この店の中でこのケーキが一番おいしい
current.kana: このみせのなかでこのけーきがいちばんおいしい

structure_explanation.en: Once again the superlative 〜のなかで〜がいちばん〜 appears, 'among X, Y is the most 〜'. この店の中で ('among the items in this store') is the compared set, with この ('this') modifying 店; このケーキが points out the winning item with が; and 一番おいしい ('the tastiest') joins 一番 to the い-adjective おいしい. 店 ('store') here is equivalent to a restaurant/café that sells cakes.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Mais uma vez aparece o superlativo 〜のなかで〜がいちばん〜, 'dentre X, Y é o mais 〜'. この店の中で ('dentre os itens desta loja') é o conjunto comparado, com この ('este/esta') modificando 店; このケーキが aponta o item vencedor com が; e 一番おいしい ('o mais gostoso') une 一番 ao い-adjetivo おいしい. 店 ('loja') aqui equivale a um restaurante/café que vende bolos.

translation_literal.en: In this store, this cake is the most delicious.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Dentro desta loja, quanto a este bolo, é o mais gostoso.

translation.en: This cake is the most delicious one in this store.
translation.pt-BR: Deste restaurante, este bolo é o mais gostoso.

note.en: dictionary form (present) of おいしい, an i-adjective
note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário (presente) de おいしい, い-adjetivo

objections.objection: The op fixed only the English side. The pt-BR translation keeps the mirror-image non-idiomatic partitive fronting that was rejected in en ('Deste restaurante, este bolo é o mais gostoso' for この店の中で; natural pt-BR is 'Neste restaurante…'), and it now also diverges lexically from the corrected en, which switched to 'store'.
objections.auditor_hint: Neste restaurante, este bolo é o mais gostoso.

current.kana: ついたち (fuse １+日 into one token)にちにおきゅうりょうがはいる

structure_explanation.en: The sentence sets the time with １日に (on the 1st) and has as its subject お給料 (the salary, with the お of politeness) marked by が, ending in the intransitive verb 入る (to come in). 入る here means 'to come in/be deposited (into the account)', something that happens on its own; that is why the subject comes with が. The focus is the vocabulary 給料 (salary).
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase situa o tempo com １日に (no dia 1) e tem como sujeito お給料 (o salário, com o お de polidez) marcado por が, fechando no verbo intransitivo 入る (entrar). 入る aqui significa 'entrar/cair (na conta)', algo que acontece por si; por isso o sujeito vem com が. O foco é o vocabulário 給料 (salário).

translation_literal.en: On the 1st, the salary comes in.

translation.en: My salary comes in on the 1st.

tokens.r: ついたち (fuse １+日 into one token)

role.en: time noun (part of the date: the 1st)
role.pt-BR: substantivo de tempo (parte da data: dia 1)

note.en: dictionary form of 入る (はいる), intransitive verb, present/future
note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário de 入る (はいる), verbo intransitivo, presente/futuro

objections.objection: tokens[0].r was set to the literal string "ついたち (fuse １+日 into one token)" instead of a reading, and the fusion the op called for was never performed: tokens[1] (日) still carries r=にち. Token readings therefore concatenate to ついたち+にち, contradicting the sentence kana and the taught meaning 'the 1st of the month'.
objections.auditor_hint: Merge tokens 0 and 1 into one token {s: "１日", r: "ついたち"} and renumber the remaining token indices.

current.kana: かのじょとわかれてかなしい

structure_explanation.en: The sentence links two ideas with the te-form of the verb 別れる (to part): 別れて works as 'having parted / after parting', serving as the cause for the final adjective 悲しい (sad). The particle と marks 彼女 (her) as the person with whom the parting occurred. It is a casual sentence, without だ or です at the end, common when describing a feeling. The vocabulary focus here is 別れる.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase liga duas ideias com a forma て do verbo 別れる (separar-se): 別れて funciona como 'tendo me separado / depois de me separar', servindo de causa para o adjetivo final 悲しい (triste). A partícula と marca 彼女 (ela) como a pessoa com quem houve a separação. É uma frase casual, sem だ ou です no fim, comum quando se descreve um sentimento. O foco de vocabulário aqui é 別れる.

translation_literal.en: Having broken up with her, I'm sad.

translation.en: I'm sad that I broke up with her.
translation.pt-BR: Fiquei triste depois de terminar com ela.

gloss.en: to break up, to end (a relationship)

note.en: te-form of 別れる, linking to the following clause
note.pt-BR: forma て de 別れる, ligando à oração seguinte

note.en: dictionary form of the i-adjective 悲しい
note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário do い-adjetivo 悲しい

objections.objection: The op's defect (悲しい is non-past; 'I felt sad after breaking up' wrongly pushes the sadness into the past and reads as mere sequence) was fixed only in en (now 'I'm sad that I broke up with her.'). translation.pt-BR still reads 'Fiquei triste depois de terminar com ela.' — the identical past/sequence error, in the primary learner locale. After the patch en and pt-BR no longer describe the same sentence, and pt-BR also contradicts its own lit_pt '(estou) triste'.
objections.auditor_hint: Estou triste porque terminei com ela.

current.jp: この祭りは県下で有名です
current.kana: このまつりわけんかでゆうめいです

structure_explanation.en: この祭り ('this festival') is the topic, marked by は. 県下で ('within the prefecture') indicates the scope in which the festival is famous. 有名 is a な-adjective (形状詞 type), and that is why it links directly to です without 'な' before です. The structure is typical: [topic] は [place] で [な-adjective] です.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: この祭り ('este festival') é o tópico, marcado por は. 県下で ('dentro do estado') indica o âmbito em que o festival é famoso. 有名 é um adjetivo-な (formato 形状詞), e por isso liga-se direto a です sem 'な' antes do です. A estrutura é típica: [tópico] は [lugar] で [adjetivo-な] です.

translation_literal.en: As for this festival, within the prefecture, it is famous.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto a este festival, dentro da província, famoso é.

translation.en: This festival is famous in the prefecture.
translation.pt-BR: Esse festival é famoso no estado.

note.en: な-adjective 有名, linked directly to です
note.pt-BR: adjetivo-な 有名, ligado direto a です

note.en: です, polite form of the present
note.pt-BR: です, forma educada do presente

objections.objection: The op flagged that en said 'state' while lit_en/expl_en say 'prefecture' (県). Only en was corrected ('This festival is famous in the prefecture.'), leaving pt-BR as 'Esse festival é famoso no estado.' The record now renders 県 three different ways in pt (expl_pt 'dentro do estado', lit_pt 'dentro da província', translation 'no estado') and en/pt-BR diverge where they previously agreed.
objections.auditor_hint: Esse festival é famoso na província. (and align expl_pt 'dentro do estado' to 'dentro da província')

current.jp: どうして日本語を勉強しますか
current.kana: どうしてにほんごをべんきょうしますか

structure_explanation.en: The sentence begins with どうして (why) and ends with the polite question 勉強しますか. The object 日本語 (the Japanese language) is marked by を, and the verb 勉強する (to study) appears in the polite form 勉強します, with final か to indicate a question. The target is どうして, which opens a question about the reason.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase começa com どうして (por quê) e termina com a pergunta polida 勉強しますか. O objeto 日本語 (língua japonesa) é marcado por を, e o verbo 勉強する (estudar) aparece na forma polida 勉強します, com か final para indicar pergunta. O alvo é どうして, que abre uma pergunta sobre o motivo.

translation_literal.pt-BR: Por que, (quanto a) o japonês, (você) estuda?

role.en: nominal head of the compound verb (勉強する)
role.pt-BR: núcleo nominal do verbo composto (勉強する)

role.en: main verb (verbal part of 勉強する)
role.pt-BR: verbo principal (parte verbal de 勉強する)

note.en: stem of する used before ます
note.pt-BR: radical de する usado antes de ます
